## Summary
Fredrick Momanyi Morara is an early-career Full-Stack and Applied AI Developer specializing in modern production web applications powered by practical AI integrations, RAG pipelines, and cloud backend environments. He designs, builds, and deploys high-performance web systems using React 19, Next.js 16, NestJS 11, Node.js, Python 3.14, and AWS Bedrock.

---

## Core Technical Skills
- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand, Framer Motion, HTML5, Vanilla CSS
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, NestJS 11, Express, REST APIs, GraphQL, Swagger / OpenAPI, Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- **Applied AI & LLMs**: AWS Bedrock AgentCore, ReAct Loops, RAG Pipelines, Vector Databases (Pinecone, Supabase pgvector), OpenAI API, Hugging Face, LangChain, Prompt Engineering, Linear SVM (scikit-learn)
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS (Lambda, Bedrock, S3, IAM, Nova 2), Microsoft Azure, Docker, Neon Serverless Postgres, Vercel, Supabase
- **Databases & ORMs**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma ORM, Drizzle ORM, Mongoose
- **Integrations**: M-Pesa Daraja Payment API, Better Auth, Clerk Auth, Nodemailer

## Key Projects

### 1. Flic Movies (Enterprise-Grade Streaming Monorepo)
- **URL**: https://flicmovies.me
- **Case Study**: https://freddymorara.tech/work/flic-movies
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/fredymorara/movies
- **Stack**: Next.js 16, NestJS 11, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL
- **Description**: Monorepo streaming web application pairing a dynamic SSR frontend with an enterprise-grade, JWT-secured NestJS backend, complete with Redis caching and Prisma ORM.

### 2. Wave Anime (High-Performance Streaming Platform)
- **URL**: https://anime.flicmovies.me
- **Case Study**: https://freddymorara.tech/work/wave-anime
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/fredymorara/wave
- **Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, Zustand, Tailwind CSS v4, Neon Serverless DB, Drizzle ORM, Node.js, Better Auth
- **Description**: Anime tracking and streaming web application featuring cross-device progress synchronization, video player auto-skip, community forums, and a cyberpunk admin dashboard.

### 3. AWS Bedrock Travel Assistant (Autonomous AI Agent)
- **Case Study**: https://freddymorara.tech/work/aws-bedrock-assistant
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/fredymorara/AWS-Travel-Assistant
- **Stack**: AWS Bedrock AgentCore, AWS Lambda, Python 3.12, MCP Gateway, Amazon Nova 2
- **Description**: Multi-tool autonomous agent running on Bedrock AgentCore, orchestrating external search and live weather tools via MCP gateways for real-time travel recommendations.

### 4. Programmatic AI Orchestration (Local Travel Planner)
- **Case Study**: https://freddymorara.tech/work/programmatic-ai
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/fredymorara/Programmatic-AI-Orchestration
- **Stack**: AWS Bedrock Converse API, Python 3.14, boto3, Amazon Nova 2
- **Description**: Autonomous ReAct agent implementing raw Bedrock Converse API function-calling for fine-grained tool loop execution and schema validation.

### 5. AWS Restaurant Agent (ReAct Recommendation Agent)
- **Case Study**: https://freddymorara.tech/work/restaurant-agent
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/fredymorara/AWS-Restaurant-Recommendation-Agent
- **Stack**: AWS Bedrock, AWS Lambda, Python 3.14, MCP, Amazon Nova 2
- **Description**: Autonomous dining recommendation agent using strict ReAct looping over Bedrock to parse requirements and query verified live restaurant inventory.

### 6. Smart AI Library Assistant (RAG Pipeline)
- **URL**: https://ai-library-update.vercel.app/
- **Case Study**: https://freddymorara.tech/work/smart-ai-library
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/fredymorara/libra-front
- **Stack**: React, Next.js, RAG Pipeline, Vector Databases, Hugging Face, Groq, Supabase, Clerk
- **Description**: Intelligent semantic search and RAG assistant enabling students to query library collections and receive context-grounded citations.

### 7. AI Spam Message Detector (Machine Learning)
- **URL**: https://aispamdetector.streamlit.app/
- **Case Study**: https://freddymorara.tech/work/ai-spam-detector
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/fredymorara/AI-Spam-Detector-App
- **Stack**: Python, scikit-learn, Streamlit, NLTK, Pandas, NumPy, Linear SVM
- **Description**: Real-time SMS and email spam classifier achieving 98%+ precision via TF-IDF vectorization and Linear SVM classification.

### 8. Student Welfare Management System (Fintech & Admin)
- **URL**: https://kabarakstudentwelfare.netlify.app/
- **Case Study**: https://freddymorara.tech/work/student-welfare-system
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/fredymorara/wms
- **Stack**: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, M-Pesa Daraja API, JWT, Tailwind CSS
- **Description**: Comprehensive university welfare portal handling emergency requests, automated approval workflows, and automated mobile money disbursements via Kenya's Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja API.

### 9. HansCredit (Fintech Loan Application)
- **URL**: https://hans-credit.vercel.app/

- **GitHub**: https://github.com/fredymorara/HansCredit

- **Description**: Streamlined personal and business credit application platform with automated email notification dispatch and application status tracking.
